message.content:
Add a TEST SUITE + a `check` script for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon, using ONLY Node's built-in test runner (no new deps). Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## CONTEXT
- Node's `node:test` + `node:assert` are available (no install needed). Target PURE modules that don't import Next/Prisma so tests run without a build:
  - `lib/billing-terms.ts` — `vpsTerm(months)`, `vpsTermPriceCents(monthlyCents, months)` (commitment discounts −10/−15/−20%), `addMonths`.
  - `lib/totp.ts` — `generateTOTP`/`verifyTOTP` (RFC 6238; test the reference vector: secret base32 "GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ" style, or generate+verify round-trip and a wrong-code rejection), `base32` round-trip.
  - `lib/rate-limit.ts` — `checkRateLimit(key,{max,windowMs})` allows `max` then blocks; `resetRateLimit` clears.
  - `lib/growth.ts` — `generateReferralCode()` format/uniqueness-ish, `describeCoupon`.
  - `lib/games.ts` — `GAME_FAMILIES` shape.
  READ each module first to test its REAL exported API (don't invent signatures). If a module transitively imports Prisma/Next, skip it (note why) — only test genuinely pure ones.
- These modules use TS + ESM path alias `@/`. Node's test runner can't resolve TS/`@/` directly. So write tests as `.mjs` that import the **compiled** output? No build is available. Instead: write tests against the module logic by importing via `tsx` — the project has `tsx` (used to run the worker). Use `node --import tsx --test test/**/*.test.ts` OR `npx tsx --test`. VERIFY which works by checking `package.json`/`tsx` availability; prefer `npx tsx --test test/*.test.ts`. Use relative imports (`../lib/xxx`) not `@/` in tests to avoid alias resolution issues.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
- CREATE test files under `test/` (e.g. `test/billing-terms.test.ts`, `test/totp.test.ts`, `test/rate-limit.test.ts`, `test/growth.test.ts`).
- EDIT `package.json` (SOLE editor this batch) — add scripts ONLY: `"test": "tsx --test test/*.test.ts"` (adjust to whatever actually runs), and `"check": "tsc --noEmit && npm test"`. Do not change deps.
- Optionally `scripts/check.sh`.

## VERIFY
Actually RUN your tests (`npx tsx --test test/*.test.ts` or `npm test`) and confirm they pass. Iterate until green. (Running tests is allowed; do NOT run `npm run build`/prisma/restart/commit.)

## HARD RULES
Never touch schema/next.config/layouts/Shell/lib(non-test)/app/worker/ROADMAP/docs or other files. No new npm deps. No commit/push.

## REPORT
Test files + what they cover, the exact command that runs them green (paste the passing summary), the `package.json` scripts added, any modules you had to skip and why.
